events.speaker: Speaker A
events.title: Claim needs support
events.summary: States that rents fell forty percent without naming a source or period.
events.evidence: Rents came down by about forty percent after that policy passed.

events.speaker: Speaker B
events.title: Position restated unfairly
events.summary: Recasts the opposing view as wanting no regulation at all, which was not argued.
events.evidence: So your position is that we should just let developers build whatever they want anywhere.

events.speaker: Speaker A
events.title: Conflicts with an earlier statement
events.summary: Now says permitting speed is irrelevant after earlier calling it the main constraint.
events.evidence: Permitting timelines are really beside the point here.

events.speaker: Speaker B
events.title: Question not answered
events.summary: Asked for the cost per unit and answers with a general statement about priorities.
events.evidence: What matters is that we are finally treating this as an emergency.

events.speaker: Speaker A
events.title: Conclusion skips a step
events.summary: Concludes that supply alone fixes affordability without establishing the link.
events.evidence: Build more units and affordability takes care of itself.
